svg.title: Gizmo: Gone to Rust
svg.desc: A speck of rust static hops in along the floor and latches onto Gizmo's lower tip. A patch of rust appears there. He looks down, shakes the leg, and blinks it off as nothing. Then the rust climbs in hard steps. He stretches and leans away from it, eyes wide. His outer side snaps into a jagged kink with a white flash and green chips fly off. One brow breaks into a zigzag. He trembles as the rust takes his curve. The top of him cracks into a crooked peak, his right eye swells and turns pale yellow, and he stretches up tall, looking at the sky. He sags. The last bend snaps, his left eye shrinks and yellows, and he writhes. Only the tip of his inner end is still green. It flickers and goes dark. He slumps with his eyes shut. They open. He rises in three jerks as a flickering rust Gremlin with one dim green tip, and cackles. Ten seconds on a transparent background.
